description: 臺北市政府捷運工程局常見問答 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺北市政府捷運工程局. 臺北市政府捷運工程局常見工程相關不同問題，局、處依民眾需求分類詳加說明回答等資料提供，即時更新以達解除民眾疑惑而更加了解捷運工程。. Coverage: 臺北市政府捷運工程局. The portal files it under the publisher 臺北市政府捷運工程局. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2026-08-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
